findings.summary: SpiceyPy 6.0.3 omits its usual error-check decorator for OSCLTX. Treating the apparent output as success would miss a sticky CSPICE diagnostic and contaminate the next call.
findings.repair: Keep the actual sp.oscltx invocation and call sp.check_for_spice_error(sp.oscltx) immediately afterward, before examining any returned fields. The native and WASM shim independently uses the 20-word ABI allocation and its normal error capture/reset.
